name: weight_norm_interface_backward
description: Representative schema: aten::_weight_norm_interface_backward(Tensor grad_w, Tensor saved_v, Tensor saved_g, Tensor saved_norms, int dim) -> (Tensor, Tensor). Computes gradients for weight-normalization direction and magnitude without mutating saved inputs. Tests cover both outputs, supported floating dtypes, first/last dimensions, representative ranks, noncontiguous layout, output shape/dtype metadata, and valid norms produced by the paired forward interface.
